entry.title: Druxt 0.25.0 is out, the first release of my Fully Decoupled Drupal…
entry.content:
Druxt 0.25.0 is out, the first release of my Fully Decoupled Drupal framework for Nuxt since 2023.
The Nuxt server now caches what Drupal sends, for as long as Drupal's Cache-Control says. A docs page on druxtjs.org went from 17 requests to Drupal to none, with content caching on.
How many times does your site ask Drupal the same question?
https://stuar.tc/writing/druxt-0250-caching-and-performance-buffs-20261023
